signature.name: VTask.of
signature.type: {R : Type u_3} -> {Γ₀ : Type u_4} -> [Ring R] -> [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] -> (f : R → Γ₀) -> (h0 : f 0 = ⊤) -> (h1 : f 1 = 0) -> (hadd : ∀ (x y : R), min (f x) (f y) ≤ f (x + y)) -> (hmul : ∀ (x y : R), f (x * y) = f x + f y) -> AddValuation R Γ₀

conventions.statement: Evaluating the constructed additive valuation at any ring element `r` returns `f r`: `(VTask.of f h0 h1 hadd hmul) r = f r`.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {Γ₀ : Type*} [Ring R] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] (f : R → Γ₀) (h0 : f 0 = ⊤) (h1 : f 1 = 0) (hadd : ∀ x y : R, min (f x) (f y) ≤ f (x + y)) (hmul : ∀ x y : R, f (x * y) = f x + f y), (VTask.of f h0 h1 hadd hmul) 0 = ⊤

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {Γ₀ : Type*} [Ring R] [LinearOrderedAddCommMonoidWithTop Γ₀] (f : R → Γ₀) (h0 : f 0 = ⊤) (h1 : f 1 = 0) (hadd : ∀ x y : R, min (f x) (f y) ≤ f (x + y)) (hmul : ∀ x y : R, f (x * y) = f x + f y) (x y : R), (VTask.of f h0 h1 hadd hmul) (x * y) = (VTask.of f h0 h1 hadd hmul) x + (VTask.of f h0 h1 hadd hmul) y
